Method of Attack: Compromises Windows containers to backdoor Kubernetes clusters
Exploits known vulnerabilities impacting web servers and databases
Uses container escape tactics to achieve code execution on Kubernetes nodes
Probes compromised nodes for credentials to spread within the cluster
Establishes communication with command-and-control server via IRC over Tor
Backdoors clusters to enable credential theft, data exfiltration, ransomware, and supply chain attacks
Discoverer: Unit 42 researchers Ariel Zelivansky and Matthew Chiodi
Attack Vector: Exploitation of vulnerabilities in web servers and databases
IRC communication over Tor network with C2 server
Indicators of Compromise: Command-and-control server hosting 313 users with 23 active victims
Technical details and IOCs available in Prizmant's report
